coverage_override.reason: The hand summon procedure plus resulting WIND lock are one procedure unit; the reveal/summon/Xyz detach trigger plus HOPT is the second.

effects.printed_clause: Empty field or Dragon Xyz hand Special Summon procedure, followed by a WIND Special Summon lock for the turn.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable hand procedure checks the printed field condition; its operation registers the WIND Special Summon restriction through the End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers a procedure-result Special Summon restriction with phase reset.

effects.printed_clause: If detached from a Stellaer Xyz to activate its effect: reveal a Stellaer in hand; Special Summon it and this card, then optionally Xyz Summon a Stellaer using those two. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GLOBALFLAG_DETACH_EVENT and EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL catch the detach in any destination. The cost reveals and retains the hand monster; resolution summons it together with this handler from its current destination, then optionally Xyz Summons using exactly those two.

official_references.matched_structure: Registers a detached-card trigger on EVENT_DETACH_MATERIAL.
Performs an immediate Xyz Summon during effect resolution using a constrained material group.

effects.issue: Fixed: the trigger no longer requires the detached card to be sent to the GY, and operation metadata now includes banishment as a possible current location.
